next_attempt_18_strategy.name: incremental ninja resume across poweroffs
next_attempt_18_strategy.rationale: lane infra poweroffs are unavoidable from our side (no elevation, no touching lane procs, podman/wslc only). Each poweroff only kills the in-flight TU. A bare ninja -j1 resume in the persisted build dir accumulates progress across restarts until the .so links.
steps: fresh configure+initial build via LF script (or cmake --build) on a live boot
on each VM restart: cd build dir && ninja -j1 (no rm -rf, no re-seed) -> resumes from existing .o
when ninja completes: .so exists -> assemble wheel (uv build --no-build-isolation with existing build dir or pip wheel)
risks: scikit-build-core may regenerate/clean build dir on uv build - use bare cmake/ninja in build dir for accumulation, wheel assembly at end
poweroff mid-write could corrupt a .o - ninja recompiles corrupt TUs
lane infra may not leave VM idle long enough even for ninja resume steps
